metadata.title: Replay and Retention

props.name: capability
props.remarks: Business capability for governing message retention, replay authorization, and time‑based trust risks in system‑to‑system integrations.

props.name: technology-domain
props.remarks: Integration storage layers, event logs, message retention mechanisms, and replay controls.

props.name: architecture-pattern
props.remarks: Supporting Zero Trust pattern defining time‑based integration risk and explicit replay authority.

props.name: data-pattern
props.remarks: Defines retained messages and events as time‑bound trust data whose reuse may amplify or reintroduce risk.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Controls governing data retention, reuse, and access restrictions (IA, SC, MP, PL families).

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Zero Trust guidance asserting that past trust does not imply future authorization and must be re‑evaluated.

props.name: nist-guidance
props.remarks: Guidance for logging, auditing, and monitoring message replay and retention activity.

metadata.remarks: Replay and Retention governs how messages and events persist over time and when they may be reused. This pattern treats replay as a privileged, policy‑controlled action and does not authorize message semantics, business effects, or lifecycle decisions.

components.title: Retention Policy Enforcement
components.description: Definition and enforcement of how long integration messages or events are retained.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Abuse of retained data to reintroduce outdated or sensitive events.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Retention governance limits temporal attack surface.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Retention periods for system data are defined and enforced.

components.title: Replay Authorization
components.description: Explicit control over who may replay retained messages or events and under what conditions.

props.name: attack-technique
props.remarks: Unauthorized replay of legitimate messages to induce repeated effects.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Explicit replay authorization prevents unintended reuse of trust.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Only explicitly authorized entities may initiate replay of retained integration data.

components.title: Temporal Abuse Detection
components.description: Detection of misuse or anomalous patterns in replay or retention usage.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Monitoring identifies replay misuse and time‑based anomalies.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Replay and retention activity is monitored and reviewed.

components.title: Temporal Non-Equivalence Constraints
components.description: Explicitly defines what message retention or replay does not grant or imply.

props.name: defense-technique
props.remarks: Non‑equivalence guarantees prevent over‑trust of historic data.

implemented-requirements.remarks: Retention or replay of messages does not imply validity, authorization, or correctness.
